verdict.rationale: Both studies examine the association of milk intake with BMI z-score in children/adolescents. A (cross-sectional, n=7116) reports a significant negative association (β=-0.103, p<0.001) and concludes a protective effect. B (longitudinal birth cohort, n=720) explicitly concludes milk intake 'was not associated with BMI z scores' (0.022; 95% CI -0.007 to 0.052; P=0.13). An explicit no-association conclusion against a reported effect takes the not_replicated branch, despite the small same-sign point estimate in B.
